Bangladesh MP Demands Apology from India Over Support for Sheikh Hasina

A Member of Parliament in Bangladesh, Nahid Islam, has demanded an apology from India for its support of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Islam made these remarks in the Bangladeshi parliament, targeting the new Indian High Commissioner. The statements have reportedly increased tensions and led to calls for India to apologize.
